items.title: The AI Daily Brief: Artificial Intelligence News and Analysis
AI is making your life more expensive. Here's how
items.summary:
But the not-so-good news: AI is pushing inflation higher and further compounding longstanding affordability concerns in the process. Plus, these price pressures aren’t expected to go away anytime soon, and they very well could broaden.

That potential dynamic has Federal Reserve officials, including the central bank’s new chairman, on alert.

Here’s a look at where AI has already shown up in inflation and where it could crop up next.

## Electricity [...] “The higher inflation means that households must spend just over $375 more to purchase the same goods and services as they did this time last year due to AI’s inflationary impact,” Mark Zandi, chief economist at Moody’s Analytics, wrote in an email to CNN.

The good news: AI is still just a minor contributor (an estimated 0.2 percentage points) of overall inflation, and the impacts are currently limited to a handful of categories. [...] Late last month, Apple hiked the prices for some of its most popular products by roughly 20%. In a statement, the company noted that AI data centers created an “extraordinary surge” in demand for memory and storage.

Sony upped the price of its PlayStation console earlier this year, and Microsoft last month raised the price of its Xbox consoles by about 25% for similar reasons.

items.title: Amazon overhauls its AI strategy, winding down most flagship models
items.summary:
The changes mark a major shift in Amazon's AI ambitions. Just last year, AWS used its re:Invent conference to unveil Nova Omni 2 as its flagship multimodal reasoning model. In 2023, CEO Andy Jassy personally championed AGI as the team that would build Amazon's most ambitious foundation models, prompting the creation of six new research groups.

Less than three years later, the organization is retiring parts of its flagship Nova lineup and reorganizing around a new frontier model effort. [...] Read in app

Giúp chúng tôi hiểu cách khách truy cập tương tác với website thông qua thu thập thông tin ẩn danh.

Thông báo

Cho phép website gửi các thông báo cần thiết, nhắc nhở hoặc cập nhật liên quan đến dịch vụ. [...] Chuyên đề cũng nhấn mạnh liêm chính khoa học là nền tảng của mọi hoạt động nghiên cứu. Các nguyên tắc trung thực, minh bạch, công bằng và trách nhiệm được phn tích gắn với những vi phạm như ngụy tạo dữ liệu, làm sai lệch kết quả và đạo văn.
